text: It’s reasonable for a woman to want support, since after all, she has to provide for her potential children, but it muddies the waters for me. I’m not stupid; I understand that she might really love me while still wanting money, stability, children, a visa, a home, etc. Men aren’t a different species, although sometimes I think I might be. A man can really love a woman for who she is while also seeing her as a source of sex, children, social legitimacy, or help running the house.
section: Being wanted for what you provide
reader: Someone wondering whether they are loved for themselves or for what they bring.
